The main takeaway from our work is that
NSFD schemes can be constructed that preserve the conservation laws associated with conservative dynamical systems and that are explicit and linear.
the resulting representations can be applied directly to a broad class of nonlinear oscillators, without the need for any additional tuning of parameters or coefficients.
